12. ASSISTED VAGINAL BIRTH (AVB):

- 10 – 15%

- Nulliparous 1/3

Indications:

311.Fetal:
-CTG – Pathological
-FBS – Abnormal
-Thick meconium

 

312.Maternal:

1. Lack of progress

-primi: (a). 3 hours with epidural (b). 2 hours without epidural
-multi: (a). 2 hours with epidural (b). 1 hour without epidural

2. maternal exhaustion

3. Medical conditions:

-HTN, Cardiac, myasthenia gravis
-SCI
313.Combine

 

 

Consent

 

Verbal Written

LR OT

Information regarding AVB

In AN period

In Reductant patient => Experienced obstetrician should do AVB

 

 

 

 

 

 

Decision Making for Assisted Birth:

Factors affecting AVB:

314.Continuous support AVB
315.Epidural AVB but less likely with newer techniques
316.Epidural in latent phase don’t risk
317.Women in labour should adapt position to reduce AVB

Upright, lateral – without epidural

Lateral – with epidural

318.To reduce AVB
319.Delayed pushing 1 – 2 hours
320.Don’t discontinue epidural in 2nd stage
321.Don’t use syntocinon routinely in 2nd stage
322.Don’t use manual rotation routinely

 

 

Classification of AVB

Outlet low mid cavity

Scalp visible on perineum

Rotation <45

 

 

Safety criteria for assisted vaginal Birth:

Caput: S/C extra periosteal serosanguineous fluid collection

Cephalohematoma: sup periosteal, well defined, commonly don’t cross midline

Subgaleal: or subaponeurotic Haemorrhage, Cross midline due to multiple attempts of vacuum, fluctuant mass.

Extradural chignon: Temporary swelling @ vacuum cup application site.

routine – Nulliparous and Forceps.

Care after AVB:

⇨Single dose of Ampicillin and clavulanic acid => Recommended after AVB
⇨Hygiene
⇨NSAIDs and Paracetamol routinely
⇨Risk of urinary retention so inform regarding Bladder emptying
⇨Urinary retention => post-void volume
⇨Physiotherapy @ 3m0 offer to reduce urinary incontinence (38 – 31%)
⇨Indwelling catheter 6 – 12 hours after AVB in regional anesthesia.
⇨Post – traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) assessment of symptoms @ 1m0 and referral to skilled professionals.

Future Birth:

⇨More chances of spontaneous labour after AVB (80% after AVB and 30% after 2nd stage C/S).
⇨3RD AND 4th degree tear individual care plan in upcoming deliveries.
